Macau Exam Practice — macau430.com
===================================

What this site is
-----------------
macau430.com is a browser-based practice application for the Macau Special Administrative Region government civil service open exams known as the 430 and 260 comprehensive ability assessments (綜合能力評估開考). It helps candidates drill multiple-choice questions with immediate feedback and explanations.

Who it is for
-------------
- People preparing for 430 (學士學位程度) or 260 (技術員程度) unified assessments
- Users who want category practice (法律、數學、圖表分析、推理邏輯、閱讀理解), challenge mode, wrong-question review, and spaced repetition

Languages
---------
Primary UI and content: Traditional Chinese (zh-TW).

What it is NOT
--------------
- Not an official SAFP / 公職局 website
- Not a registration or examination portal
- Does not guarantee exam content matches future official papers

Official source
---------------
Macau public service open exam information:
http://concurso-uni.safp.gov.mo/

Technical
---------
Single-page application (React). Static SEO files at site root: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt. User progress stored locally in the browser (localStorage).
